item.title: Yakan Tenun
item.description: Proudly displaying her “Os inalaman,” a tenun (Yakan weave) used as hip wraparound to complete a woman traditional attire, Mary Ann Taala, 45, is selling her produce at the provincial capitol of Basilan in Isabela City in time for the 18-Day Campaign to End Violence Against Women. The campaign runs from November 25 to December 12, 2025. MindaNews photo by JULES L. BENITEZ
